title: SimpleCraftableNametags
description: This mod adds crafting recipe for nametags from the 26.1 version
body:
![LOGO](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ae36f029bef9fd878c30f3fc783106bb3c4061de.png)

This mod adds the new nametag recipe introduced by Minecraft in the new 26.1 version (still in snapshot) to versions 1.20.1 and 1.21.1, at least for now, as I plan to extend it to other versions later.

![CRAFTING](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a162217b2d7b774c5015b1dd4ed6c54894b4219d.png)
